definitions.explanation: A formal agreement between parties, especially between organizations or countries.

examples.japanese: {両国|りょうこく}は{貿易|ぼうえき}{協定|きょうてい}を{結|むす}んだ。
examples.english: The two countries signed a trade agreement.

examples.japanese: {労使|ろうし}{協定|きょうてい}を{締結|ていけつ}する。
{協定|きょうてい}に{違反|いはん}する。

notes:
{協定|きょうてい} refers to a formal agreement between organizations, governments, or parties. It implies mutual negotiation and consensus, composed of {協|きょう} (cooperate) + {定|てい} (fix/determine).

COMMON TYPES:
- {貿易|ぼうえき}{協定|きょうてい}: trade agreement
- {労使|ろうし}{協定|きょうてい}: labor-management agreement
- {国際|こくさい}{協定|きょうてい}: international agreement
- {自由|じゆう}{貿易|ぼうえき}{協定|きょうてい}: free trade agreement (FTA)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {協定|きょうてい}を{結|むす}ぶ: to conclude an agreement
- {協定|きょうてい}を{締結|ていけつ}する: to sign/conclude an agreement (formal)
- {協定|きょうてい}に{違反|いはん}する: to violate an agreement

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {条約|じょうやく}: treaty (formal, between nations, often with legal force)
- {契約|けいやく}: contract (business or personal, legally binding)
- {合意|ごうい}: mutual agreement, consensus (less formal than {協定|きょうてい})
- {同盟|どうめい}: alliance (broader political/military relationship)
